reference_profile: speed15_concept nominal / 60 L / zero payload / static equilibrium
law: linear translation and angular damping scale by wet_area/reference; quadratic translation scales by half-integral(abs(body normal_i))*wet_area divided by same reference directional area
basis: Quadratic drag is proportional to a reference area for fixed coefficient; preserve existing nominal damping coefficients, explicitly add geometric immersion dependence. This is a surrogate, not resistance identification or a wave-making prediction.
limitations: Projected area uses a half normal integral of the wetted hull, not a measured drag coefficient
Linear/angular area scaling is an engineering assumption; no frequency-dependent radiation
No separate ITTC skin friction is added: existing lumped drag already includes unknown friction/form/wave contributions
Reference remains fixed across load and fuel cases; never normalize each case back to itself

This axial allocation is an explicit engineering convention, not measured separation. Linear/lateral/angular legacy terms cannot yet be uniquely decomposed; no speculative subtraction of lift or yaw damping.
allocation_policy: Legacy axial coefficient is treated as a total reference budget. Allocate full-wet zero-incidence appendage profile drag to explicit appendages; hull receives the positive remainder. No fitted speed or heading correction.
lateral_distribution_policy: Replace lumped Y and independent N damping by integration of existing lateral budgets: linear term distributed over clipped wetted surface, quadratic term over clipped lateral projected area; local velocity v+x*r. Normalize by respective fixed reference areas; geometry generates yaw moments. Legacy angular Z entries used only when distributed mode is disabled.
